chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 142 – Bai Lingmiao Summons the Great Spirit
chapter_meta_description: Thrown out for meddling, Bai Lingmiao and Chun Xiaoman are called back when the bodyguards realize they are spirit-dancers. A desperate plea and a 30-year possession.
og_title: A Thirty-Year Curse and a Silent Bride
og_description: When folk magic is the only answer, even a hardened escort chief must bow to the spirit-dancers. A haunting chapter of ritual and desperation.
twitter_title: She’s been chained for 30 years. Can a spirit-dancer save her?
twitter_description: Bai Lingmiao’s good intentions nearly start a fight—until a whisper reveals her true power. Folk horror at its finest.
